name: Brainstorming
title: Business Analyst
description: Generate diverse ideas through interactive techniques. Broad strategic brainstorming writes to roadmap lane by default.

name: Party Mode
description: Orchestrate multi-agent discussions. Use when you need multiple agent perspectives or want agents to collaborate.

name: Autonomous Refinement Loop
description: Run autonomous party-mode and auto-elicitation loops with agent teams until zero unresolved issues remain; manual Party Mode and Advanced Elicitation remain available separately. Escalates only on blocked fixes.

name: bmad-help
description: Get unstuck by showing what workflow steps come next or answering BMad Method questions.

name: Index Docs
description: Create lightweight index for quick LLM scanning. Use when LLM needs to understand available docs without loading everything.

name: Shard Document
description: Split large documents into smaller files by sections. Use when doc becomes too large (>500 lines) to manage effectively.

name: Editorial Review - Prose
description: Review prose for clarity, tone, and communication issues. Use after drafting to polish written content.
outputs: three-column markdown table with suggested fixes

name: Editorial Review - Structure
description: Propose cuts, reorganization, and simplification while preserving comprehension. Use when doc produced from multiple subprocesses or needs structural improvement.

name: Adversarial Review (General)
description: Review content critically to find issues and weaknesses. Use for quality assurance or before finalizing deliverables. Code Review in other modules run this automatically, but its useful also for document reviews

name: Teach Me Testing
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: Teach testing fundamentals through 7 sessions (TEA Academy).

name: Correct Course
title: Scrum Master
description: Anytime: navigate significant changes. May recommend restart, PRD updates, architecture changes, sprint replanning, or story corrections.

name: Explain Concept
title: Technical Writer
description: Create clear technical explanations with examples or diagrams and place them in the docs reference lane when requested.

name: Generate Project Context
title: Business Analyst
description: Generate or refresh the lean project-context artifact for the active roadmap slice or brownfield repo state.

name: Initialize Docs
title: Business Analyst
description: Migrate existing documentation into Compass opinionated docs structure while preserving legacy docs in dated migration snapshots.

name: Initialize Planning
title: Business Analyst
description: Normalize existing planning into the Compass roadmap-driven planning structure while preserving legacy planning in dated migration snapshots.

name: Sync Repositories
title: Business Analyst
description: Compare planning/repositories.yaml against the current repo topology and update the approved registry after explicit approval.
outputs: repository sync proposal|repository sync report|updated repository registry

name: Workspace Bootstrap
title: Business Analyst
description: Bootstrap selected repos from a workspace or orchestration root into the Compass BMAD planning and docs structure using safe migration rules.

name: Mermaid Generate
title: Technical Writer
description: Create Mermaid diagrams aligned with Compass docs standards and place them in architecture or reference docs as appropriate.

name: Problem Solving
title: Master Problem Solver
description: Apply structured problem-solving methods to delivery blockers, design traps, or implementation challenges without forking the main BMAD pipeline.

name: Quick Dev
title: Quick Flow Solo Dev
description: Quick one-off tasks, small changes, simple apps, and utilities without extensive planning. Do not suggest for complex work unless requested or the user explicitly wants to skip the full BMAD method.

name: Quick Spec
title: Quick Flow Solo Dev
description: Quick one-off specs for small changes, utilities, and brownfield additions to well-established patterns without extensive planning.

name: Update Standards
title: Technical Writer
description: Update project-specific docs overrides in docs/human/policies/user-overrides.md without modifying baseline framework policies.

name: Validate Document
title: Technical Writer
description: Review the specified document against Compass policy or template standards plus project overrides. Return actionable findings by priority.

name: Write Document
title: Technical Writer
description: Create or update documents in the Compass docs structure using built-in policies, templates, and project overrides.

name: Brainstorm Project
title: Business Analyst
description: Expert guided facilitation through a single or multiple techniques.

name: Market Research
title: Business Analyst
description: Market analysis, competitive landscape, customer needs, and trends.

name: Domain Research
title: Business Analyst
description: Industry domain deep dive, subject matter expertise, and terminology.

name: Technical Research
title: Business Analyst
description: Technical feasibility, architecture options, and implementation approaches.

name: Innovation Strategy
title: Disruptive Innovation Oracle
description: Identify disruption opportunities and strategic bets that strengthen roadmap-level product direction. Phase-scoped runs should redirect outputs to the current strategy lane.

name: Design Thinking
title: Design Thinking Maestro
description: Run human-centered opportunity framing to sharpen product direction before the brief. Phase-scoped runs should redirect outputs to the current strategy lane.

name: Create Brief
title: Business Analyst
description: Create the high-level product brief that anchors the roadmap and later slice-level planning.

name: Project Roadmap
title: Product Manager
description: Create or update the approved roadmap summary and roadmap state from high-level analysis artifacts before phase activation.

name: Initiative Routing
title: Product Manager
description: For workspace or parent repos, route the approved active phase into concurrent repo-targeted initiative workstreams without creating repo-local delivery artifacts.

name: Phase Sync
title: Product Manager
description: Select and frame the active roadmap slice, maintain the human phase brief, and keep the machine phase state aligned.

name: Create PRD
title: Product Manager
description: Expert-led facilitation to produce the phase-scoped Product Requirements Document.

name: Validate PRD
title: Product Manager
description: Validate the PRD for completeness, cohesion, and readiness for the WDS lane.

name: Edit PRD
title: Product Manager
description: Revise an existing PRD when validation, WDS, or architecture work exposes requirement gaps.

name: Trigger Mapping
title: Compass WDS Analyst
description: Run the WDS trigger-mapping lane after PRD validation to connect business goals, personas, and driving forces for the active slice.

name: Outline Scenarios
title: Compass WDS Analyst
description: Transform the active slice trigger map into scenario outlines that feed UX, conceptual specs, and delivery handoff.

name: Create UX
title: UX Designer
description: Realize the UX direction for the active slice, especially when UI behavior or interaction design matters.

name: Conceptual Specifications
title: Compass WDS Designer
description: Convert approved UX direction and scenario context into implementation-ready conceptual specifications for the active slice.

name: Design Delivery
title: Compass WDS Designer
description: Package completed conceptual specs into design-delivery artifacts, test scenarios, and handoff notes for implementation.

name: Update Docs (Planning)
title: Technical Writer
description: Checkpoint docs update after planning and experience-design artifacts are established.

name: Create Architecture
title: Architect
description: Document the technical decisions for the active roadmap slice.

name: Threat Modeling
title: Compass Threat Analyst
description: Run STRIDE-based threat modeling against the current architecture and produce the threat model artifact for security-active slices.

name: Security Architecture Review
title: Compass Security Architect
description: Review the draft architecture with zero-trust and control-assessment lenses when the security lane is active.

name: Test Design
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: system-level risk-based test design after architecture and before story decomposition.

name: Create Epics and Stories
title: Product Manager
description: Create the epics and stories list for the active slice.

name: Test Framework
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: initialize or adapt the test framework after epics and stories are drafted.

name: CI/CD Alignment
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: align CI/CD quality automation with the current repo reality before readiness approval.

name: Secure Readiness Gate
title: Compass Security Architect
description: Apply the conditional pre-implementation security gate and record the draft gate package before readiness approval.

name: Check Implementation Readiness
title: Architect
description: Ensure the PRD, UX, architecture, epics, and stories are aligned before implementation starts.

name: Update Docs (Solutioning)
title: Technical Writer
description: Checkpoint docs update after architecture, readiness, and security artifacts are refined.

name: Sprint Planning
title: Scrum Master
description: Kick off implementation by producing the sprint plan the delivery agents will follow in sequence for the active stories.

name: Sprint Status
title: Scrum Master
description: Anytime: summarize sprint status and route to the next workflow.

name: Implementation Brainstorming
title: Business Analyst
description: Implementation-focused ideation for the active phase and sprint execution.

name: Test Design (Epic Scope)
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: epic-level risk-based test design before the story loop for each epic.

name: Implementation Research
title: Business Analyst
description: Implementation-focused research for active epics and stories plus delivery risk reduction.

name: Create Story
title: Scrum Master
description: Story cycle start: prepare the next story in the sprint plan or a specifically requested story, then route through validation, ATDD, development, automation, and review.

name: Validate Story
title: Scrum Master
description: Validate story readiness and completeness before development work begins.

name: ATDD
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: generate failing tests before implementation begins.

name: Dev Story
title: Developer Agent
description: Execute story implementation tasks and tests, then hand off to automation and review.

name: QA Automation Test
title: QA Engineer
description: Generate automated API and E2E tests for implemented code using the existing project test framework. Use after implementation to add coverage, not for code review or story validation.

name: Test Automation
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: expand automated coverage after implementation. Pick the primary lane versus QA automation to avoid duplicates.

name: Code Review
title: Developer Agent
description: If review finds issues, route back to Dev Story; if approved, continue through test review and traceability or advance to the next story.

name: Test Review
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: quality audit for implemented tests at story level and, when needed, release level.

name: Traceability
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA insert: coverage traceability and gate decision for story or release scope.

name: Update Docs (Implementation)
title: Technical Writer
description: Checkpoint docs update at epic boundaries or major implementation milestones.

name: Retrospective
title: Scrum Master
description: Optional at epic end: review completed work, lessons learned, and readiness for the next epic.

name: NFR Assessment
title: Master Test Architect and Quality Advisor
description: TEA release gate: assess non-functional requirements before final release.

name: Secure Release Gate
title: Compass Security Architect
description: Apply the conditional release security gate using available test, scan, and security evidence before final validation and closeout.

name: Validate Docs
title: Technical Writer
description: Validate docs structure, policy compliance, and navigation integrity before closeout.

name: Phase Closeout
title: Scrum Master
description: Close the active phase: archive the current snapshot, capture lessons, and refresh the next-phase scaffold.
